title: CustomInstructionUpdate
description: Fields for updating a custom instruction. Only the fields provided are changed; omitted fields are left as they are.

title.description: Display name for the custom instruction (unique per Agent)

text.description: The instruction content — the rule the Agent should follow

enabled.description: Whether the instruction is enabled. False means inactive.

notes.description: Internal notes about this instruction (not shown to the Agent). Send an empty string to blank it; omit it to leave the existing notes unchanged.

availability_rules.description: Optional availability rule as a rule-expression string with `v("<variable_name>")` lookups. Send a non-empty string to set or replace it, `null` to clear it, or omit to leave it unchanged. A rule that references an unknown variable, or that is malformed or uses an unsupported operator, is rejected with 400.
